definition: A Visual Basic programming language for the .NET platform with object-oriented features.

definition: A human language used in spoken communication and language documentation.

definition: A Romance language used in oral and written communication, distinct from French.
example: An editor checks a Walloon dialogue for a language lesson.

definition: A standardized format for describing interactive three-dimensional scenes.

definition: A structured reporting standard for tagging business and financial facts with taxonomy concepts.
example: A preparer tags annual revenue with its reporting period and currency.

definition: A human language also known as isiXhosa.

definition: A text markup language for representing structured documents with nested elements and attributes.
example: An application reads the title and author fields of an XML book record.

definition: An XML-based markup language formerly used for Mozilla application interfaces.
example: A maintainer reads a XUL definition for a toolbar in legacy software.

definition: A human language whose written forms can mark tone using diacritics.

definition: A human language also known as isiZulu.
